items.text: The fold-glide fixes are now in a published release, and at 4K one frame in about one drag of five still misses the 16.7 ms bar.
On a 4K screen each fold-glide frame no longer copies the same column of the window to the screen twice, so its paint is about a quarter cheaper and clean release drags have no frame over 16.7 ms.
The fold-glide test now counts every frame that runs past 16.7 ms and says where the slowest one went, instead of reading a trace that at 4K kept only about half the frames.
